## Context / Problem
`docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md:72-74` says the review-bot image installs the `nava-rebar[agents]` extra with `pip install .[agents,reviewbot]`. `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md:211-215` says the compose stack runs two containers, Gerrit and review-bot, and repeats the `pip install .[agents,reviewbot]` install shape.

The current image build uses locked uv, not a bare pip install. `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:93-100` pins uv through `ghcr.io/astral-sh/uv:0.12.7` and runs `uv sync --locked --no-dev --extra agents --extra reviewbot --extra bedrock`; `pyproject.toml:353-356` pins `[tool.uv] required-version = "==0.12.7"`.

The current compose file defines four services, not two: `gerrit` at `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:27`, `review-bot` at `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:76`, `opcert` at `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:346`, and `mcp` at `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:418`. nginx remains host-side and outside compose; the service comments describe host nginx proxying to the loopback-published service ports at `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:37-38`, `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:279-280`, `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:394-395`, and `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml:407-410`.

## Approach
Update `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` to match the current review-bot Dockerfile and compose topology. Leave historical ADR prose unchanged unless the referenced lines are part of the operator guide statements above.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` removes the review-bot prerequisite claim at lines 72-74 that the image bakes `pip install .[agents,reviewbot]` and replaces it with the locked install from `infra/compose/Dockerfile.reviewbot:98-100`: uv `0.12.7` running `uv sync --locked --no-dev --extra agents --extra reviewbot --extra bedrock`.
- [x] `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` replaces the repeated `pip install .[agents,reviewbot]` claim at line 213 with the same locked uv install and mentions that `pyproject.toml:353-356` pins the required uv version to `==0.12.7`.
- [x] `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` removes the two-container topology claim at lines 211-212 and replaces it with the four compose services from `infra/compose/docker-compose.yml`: `gerrit`, `review-bot`, `opcert`, and `mcp`.
- [x] `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` keeps nginx described as host-side and outside compose, with nginx proxying to loopback-published service ports rather than listed as a compose service.
- [x] `docs/gerrit-aws-setup.md` leaves historical ADR 0007 wording unchanged outside the current operator-guide drift at lines 72-74 and 211-215.
- [x] [non-codebase] The full verify suite is green for this change, with the run and its
      exit code recorded on this ticket. The authoritative signal is the Gerrit `Verified`
      vote on this change's patch set, which runs the same selection `make test` runs.
      provenance: environment=github-actions-hosted-runner; principal=rebar-ci-bot; privilege_posture=production-equivalent; instrument=live-call — CI run 35488610331 executed the gating suite against Gerrit change 2993 patch set 1 (revision 396225b395b4e127eca37017f91eee89c509a553) and concluded SUCCESS, casting `Verified +1`; that run is the same merge gate that admits the change to `main`, so its exit status is the authoritative verify result rather than a simulation of one.

## Testing
Run `env PATH="$PWD/.venv/bin:$PATH" make verify` from the repository checkout and land only if it exits 0.
